title: Capture the original Commons IO default-charset refusal
description: The first strict native job kept the public initialization frontier. Its observation recorder expected a JSON verdict, but Commons IO reads Charset.defaultCharset before native execution begins. Re-run that same original constructor, preserving the exact pre-verifier stderr on both original JARs under ordinary and controlled process settings. The public UTF-8 histories use separate real-JVM evidence.

steps.name: Capture both original initializer refusals under both process profiles
